texts.text: ... What's goin' on here?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Oi... Are those Distortions over there?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: recognizes them as Distortions, and this place has a different name for them, but... they are Distortions.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Interior design renovation is underway at the Luxury Hall, as you can see.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Please watch your step.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Ah, apologies for the noise. This renovation is a rather large-scale construction project.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... "Renovation," eh?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: My old bossman used to say "grab yer tools, lads! We're headin' out to renovate a whole lotta mugs!" whenever we went after other Syndicates.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: That what you mean, lass?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Not exactly, no; this is just a very special refitting, quite unlike any before it—more than just switching out a few out-of-fashion displays. This time, the project is to build a cradle... in anticipation of the advent of a very important someone.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: So... what're they eatin' back there? Some kinda cannibal feast?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: We are feasting on the Noir. Though this will hardly sate our hunger...
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Please return once the construction work is complete. You will soon see this place reborn into a far grander state of beauty!
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Speaking of which... Hm, it appears your Prestige Tiers are too low to be admitted to the Luxury Hall anyway, dear customers. Please understand that the Luxury Hall is the most exclusive establishment on any floor. Naturally, its clientele has to be rigorously vetted and curated. That is to say, not just any Joe Shmoe should be allowed to waltz onto its grounds.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: The hell's a Prestige Tier? You ain't gonna let us in?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: No. I'm afraid the Luxury Hall... isn't the kind of establishment that needs to hawk to its customer base.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: It won't be long before the renovations are complete, elevating the Luxury Hall beyond even its halcyon days since the grand opening. Please return after raising your tiers if you'd like to bear witness to the magnificent sight to come.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: (She hums a nice tune, seemingly pleased with herself.)
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... It would be prudent to revisit the Luxury Hall once their "construction project" is completed.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: ... I'd rather not return at all, actually.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Raise your Prestige Rank first and come knocking again. Then, perhaps, we will reconsider your qualifications.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: <color=#515aee>For this floor...</color>
<color=#515aee>Intuition... reinforced by reason...</color>
Hah! That's child's play, lass! Lookee, it ain't no trouble reaching my elbo—
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: —oooaagh! Blimey, where am I!?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <Uh... What's up?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: L-listen, me and the lads in the restroom were just, uhm, doin' a bet, that's all. Tryin' to see if it's possible to lick one's own elbow... *cough*
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: It appears that you have discovered the means of moving between the floors, Dante.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <Yeah, spending the money—I mean, "eyeballs"—we earned here raised our spending tier and allowed us to rise to a higher floor.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <... Anyway, where's Dubois?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Dubois? What's that?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <Oh, Dubois's the guy we met on the first floor. He was supposed to work with us...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <Huh, where'd he go?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: It is likely that he has arrived at... a different "second floor" from ours.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <But he got on the escalator with us. Are you saying that the same escalator can lead to two different places at once?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: The total surface area and population of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe are both many times greater than its appearance might suggest.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: If he has gone astray somewhere in the middle, it is entirely possible to end up at a different destination despite having shared the same point of departure.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Meursault gave a light nod, affirming Faust's explanation.
And just how do you know that, lass...?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Faust knows it all. That's how.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: ... Anyway, if that's all there is to it, I'm sure we'll run into him after pokin' around for a while.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Question is, where are we pokin' first?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <First, let's get our bearings and see what's on this floor.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: A wall made of flesh and bone blocks the way. There are bodies of dead Noirs splayed around the floor past the wall.
A wall made of flesh and bone blocks the way. The Rouges who'd been guarding this place and the corpses of the Noirs both are nowhere to be seen.
We cannot go in this direction yet, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <color=#7d7d7d>Bask in the eternal light shall the Noir.</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>True permanence of the Grand Magasin... shall soon be upon us...
The very bones and bricks of the Grand Magasin shall crumble and liquefy in the absence of the Golden Resin...</color>
What in the bloody...?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: The massacre has progressed further than it had on our last visit.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Stop right there. The interior design renovation is still—
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: ... Wait, that letter...
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: ... I see. It is an honor to serve esteemed customers such as yourselves.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: Do you have it with you, the... Golden Nail?
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: Yes. An explanation of the current circumstances would be most appreciated—
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Thanks to your efforts, we are now privy to the knowledge that the Rouge God has truly forsaken them. Naught remains to stay our assault.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: Thus, we have marched here to cut off once and for all the voracious maws of the Rouge that greedily gnaw at the Golden Resin.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: As written in this letter, we shall offer you all the items in this Luxury Hall without charging a single pair of eyeballs.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: ... You need only take the Golden Nail and rip apart the horrible false god the blasphemous Rouge are birthing into this world.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: Are we takin' this deal, Clock?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <If I'm being honest, it doesn't really seem all that important to me if we're working for the right side, whether that's the Rouges or the Noirs.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <We're just here to pick up the Golden Bough we can supposedly obtain once we reach the top floor of the Grand Magasin...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <... and escape this place alongside Meursault.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <It just so happens that right now, working with the Noirs seems to give us the best chance at achieving that goal.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <... Faust? Meursault?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Yes, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Listening.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <I'd like to ask for your opinions, too.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <Do you think I'm making the right choice here? We—>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: If that is something of your choosing.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: There are no right or wrong choices.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: The important thing is—
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: ... It's nothing. I will follow your judgment, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Meursault strode forward without saying another word.
Jeanne will be saddened.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: ...? What did you just...?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: ... It seems the situation within is dire.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: I pray you make haste.
texts.speaker: อูมาร์

texts.text: <Okay, we're here with the Nail. What now?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Aaargh!!
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์

texts.text: Oh... Please do not approach so heedlessly. Muffle your steps in here, if you would.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: The Slumbering One mustn't yet wake.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Do not worry. They are sound asleep in their cradle, listening to the tender rhythms of lullabies, wrapped in the softest layers...
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: I unravel the flesh of all life and weave them anew, so that they may return as blankets to enwrap the Slumbering One in their cradle.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Don't you hear it, too? The somnolent, rhythmic inhale... and exhale, enveloped by the warmth of this nest?
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Oi, that's the same one who stood in our way earlier, innit...?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <I'll be honest, she was already pretty intimidating when things were peaceful earlier...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Ah, I remember you. You were last here to shop, weren't you?
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: I see that you've grown sophisticated enough to enter since your last visit, but... Dragging dirt and all kinds of grime in here without wiping your shoes?
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: It seems you still lack the manners to be permitted entry.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... She is preparing to attack, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: There is a 90% chance of complete annihilation, should we fail to respond properly to her attacks.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: I have committed your countenances to my memory. You will never be permitted entry to this hall as its customers, even after the completion of the renovation project.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Along with the Noirs in that stifling black fabric...
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... you are heretofore blacklisted.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: <... Looks like we're past the point of no return.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: All we need... to do... is enter the Tabernacle...
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์ที่กำลังจะตาย

texts.text: ... But... Why... can't we...?
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์ที่กำลังจะตาย

texts.text: That Tabernacle...
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: ... Is a barrier against evil and a sieve for the good.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: Though I am but a humble servant who may be defeated by difficult customers, no evil shall penetrate it before the Slumbering One is born.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: So there was somethin' else she was bankin' on aside from herself... She's basically guarding a safe.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Ah... though impregnable be the tabernacle, I must still maintain a clear path for the Slumbering One for their waking.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: The Voice... they built...
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์ที่กำลังจะตาย

texts.text: The Voice of apostasy... woven from nothing but strings and desire... Unguided by any divine message...
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์ที่กำลังจะตาย

texts.text: It is horror that awaits... from within...
texts.speaker: เลอ นัวร์ที่กำลังจะตาย

texts.text: <Finding a way to deal with that barrier is one thing, but we're first going to have to put her down.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <color=#7d7d7d>Bring vengeance of ruination upon the unclothed, upon those who dared not fear the gaze. Only then shalt peace be with those who act.</color>
<Who's saying this...?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: This is the Voice of the Chaplain.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: The Giant of Le Noir has made the judgment call.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <The Chaplain...? Ah, the Voice we heard on the first floor...!>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <color=#7d7d7d>Thus I proclaim: the divine retribution for the recalcitrant who insisted on deafness before the Voice of God, for those whose final defiance shall be their demise.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>Wield my vengeance in thy hammer of justice, my faithful child. Deliver my judgment and smite the servants of the false Crimson God.</color>
I answer your calling, Lord.
It seems there is a strange membrane that is repelling everyone trying to enter. Let's see if the knight out front knows anything.
W-whoa!
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: I know full well who ye are.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: Ye must be wielders of the "Golden Nail" the Lord hath prophesied.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: <The knight knocked her away... with a single swing...!>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: The voice that counteth out the hours findeth no purchase upon mine ears.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: The Lord hath charged me to serve as naught but the bearer of His word. What cause have I to heed any voice but His?
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: We... we are...
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Witness ye in silence,
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: for I speak now the will of the Lord.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: The Le Noir of the third floor spake thus: soon shall a false idol be wrought in the depths below. The hour hath therefore come to draw back the veil.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: And God did answer: "Receive the 'Golden Nail', which shall stand in the hammer's stead. Do so, and eternity shall be bestowed upon thee."
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... And thus it is that I now stand before ye.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: Listen, you big lass. We're just doin' whatever we chose—
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: I said, hold thy silence.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: With your Golden Nail, ye are to pierce through the cradle of that horror soon to be born, and rend it asunder.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: I shall hold back the Rouges making for this place. Make haste, and see your ordained fate fulfilled.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: <But... it didn't look like there was any way through that veil.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <We'd better ask if there's a way to get in there.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Question.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Be thou silent...
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... Hold. This gaze...
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: Thou...
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: The tabernacle's barrier cannot be torn nor permeated. How are we to progress?
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Thou, what...
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: What bond hast thou with the voice...?
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... Nay. Perhaps this, too, is but another trial laid upon me. I shall not doubt.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: Thou art but a stranger from the Fount, whom God hath made ready for this hour.
texts.speaker: ผู้จัดการแบรนด์

texts.text: <... Stranger from the Fount, huh.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <We... can slip beyond some of the rules and common sense that govern this place. And we belong to neither the Rouges nor the Noirs.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: ... I see.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: If the freedom to travel between floors is equivalent to estrangement and the lack of belonging thereof...
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: There is a possibility that we may likewise be exempt from the barrier that blocks the Noirs.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Meursault walked up to the barrier...
... and was sucked inside as though the wall itself was but an illusion.
Dante.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <Got it. Let's go.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: [미사용] 여기까지 기어온 벌레들이 있군. 명품관의 바닥을 너희 피로 닦아주마.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: [미사용] 저자가 이 전장의 원흉일세. 함께 무찌르세나!
texts.speaker: Le Noir Hammer

texts.text: <color=#E1B643>A nailed cradle, an egg cast unprepared into the world.</color>
<color=#E1B643>When its beating heart draws to a close... The world may find eternity.</color>
Wait, that voice just now—
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Dammit, that bloody voice... I remember that voice...!
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: <... It's getting clearer and clearer.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <color=#E1B643>If you have decided what is to be done with the child who slumbers... Then go as your steps take you.</color>
There is no point in letting it linger in your eyes.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: Make a judgment call, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: What to do?
Raised the Golden Nail against the cradle.
They don't look to be much of a conversationalist.
They're standing guard at their assigned post. They don't seem to have any intention of stepping aside.
They held their post until the very end.
The corpse of a Rouge. The bladed arms have all been snapped apart, leaving the body sprawled across the floor.
The corpse of a Rouge. The tentacles attached to their face begin to crawl outward, only to fall still moments later.
The corpse of a Rouge. The entire body has been crushed beneath a heavy hammer, mangled beyond recognition.
<It's just a corpse.>
<Looks like the construction is finally over.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Let us return upstairs first.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Be fast asleep... and sing to us...
texts.speaker: เทวชาด

texts.text: It's comin' closer... It looks...
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: ... No, that isn't anger. It aligns much more closely with... crying.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Grow... tall and strong...
texts.speaker: เทวชาด

texts.text: ... and sing to us... your Voice...
texts.speaker: เทวชาด

texts.text: <I don't think it even understands what it's singing...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: ... That's it, I can't listen to this anymore.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: The child who took their first steps into the world of the living now lies on the ground, dying.
Knowing nothing but the song it hums.
Sleep... tight...
texts.speaker: เทวชาด

texts.text: My... baby...
texts.speaker: เทวชาด

texts.text: Like a strand of fray that has snapped from fabric, the song came to a sudden stop.
The creature curled up into itself like a fetus. It never moved again.
<Well... What now...?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Le Noir will now assume full control of the Grand Magasin. And once that happens...
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: ... Can't we just collect what we're owed and worry about the rest later? No use splittin' our hairs over things we can do nothin' about.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: We did what we set out to do, but I don't like it one bit. It ain't like there's anything we can do by whingin' amongst ourselves.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: ... Wait. Just a moment.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: Why wasn't I told of this? Why would the Administrator Fausts— What...
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <Faust? Is this about the Gesellschaft?>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: ... I see, the Grand Magasin will now be eternal. But... that means...
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: ... Given your low Prestige Tier, I will pardon an error born of ignorance... But only this once.
texts.speaker: ผู้อำนวยการแบรนด์

texts.text: ... It has not yet matured, but its power is to be reckoned with.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: I mean, thing's supposed to be their leader, innit? 'Course it's a tough sod.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: *sigh* No turning back now... Guess we'll just have to give the bloody thing a proper thrashin'.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Perhaps... there might have been another option.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <It started with us accidentally tipping the Noirs off about the Rouges...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: <But we made the best choice we could, given what we had.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: ... Whatever. All we've gotta do is put that bastard down somehow. Then we take what we're owed... and get the bloody hell outta this shithole of a department store. That's it, innit?
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Right. Let's have another go.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Oi, oi... you... your head... you alright?!
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: As I had already died, my head has returned to the same state it was in previously.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: <Let's give up on going in there. I don't think that's an opponent we can beat... not yet, anyway.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: Tsk. Can't be helped, then.
texts.speaker: ฮีธคลิฟฟ์

texts.text: Dante, the recommended option is to first observe how the situation develops before initiating combat.
texts.speaker: เฟาสท์

texts.text: <I thought that was our opening... Guess not.>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้

texts.text: It appears we are currently unable to leave, Manager.
texts.speaker: เมอร์โซ

texts.text: The Rouge who had been guarding the entrance to the Luxury Hall lies defeated.
<Let's keep heading inside...>
texts.speaker: ดันเต้
